note: Unity sprites from the BloomLunas prototype (unity.html). No text. code = Unity sprite code (SK skin, OR ornament, IC icon), card = its card on unity.html, sheet = interface sheet parts that use it. Width and height are 1x px; PNG pixels = size x scale. nineSlicePx = Sprite Editor border in PNG pixels (left, right, top, bottom). mode = Unity Image Type (Sliced, Tiled, Simple). Pixels Per Unit = 100 x scale.
